evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: A directive performing a definitive instruction to discard knowledge — the imperative 'Forget' settles the matter operationally, not as a position to argue.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Imperative directive with absolute scope ('all knowledge') performs a definitive operational instruction, not a claim to defend.
